notes: Roster gate replaced with the 2026-27 LBPRC workbooks plus the three supplied posts.
New roster players without an existing scouting sample are included as empty records.
spray_recent_note: Each spray chart plots most recent 100 BIP (Synergy events newest-first).
bunt_sample_definition: Synergy bunt plate appearances (SacrificeBunt, BuntGroundout, BuntPopout), one per PA — LBPRC 2025 winter and MLB/MiLB/LMB 2026 summer only
summer_line_source: MLB Stats API season hitting, 2026 regular season (sportId 1 MLB, 11 AAA / 12 AA / 13 A+ / 14 A / 16 RK MiLB, 23 LMB). One row per hitter: the team assignment with the most plate appearances.
woba_definition: Baseball-Reference linear weights (documented BRef form): wOBA=(0.70*uBB+0.73*HBP+0.89*1B+1.27*2B+1.61*3B+2.07*HR+0.25*SB-0.50*CS)/(AB+BB-IBB+HBP+SF). Summer lines include SB/CS; Synergy pitch-type rows omit SB/CS. Not league-relative (not wOBA+/Rbat+). Live BRef rOBA refits per league-season.
